correctness.rationale: Diagonalize L=c L(K_a)⊗I_b+d I_a⊗L(K_b) in three mutually orthogonal nonconstant sectors with eigenvalues ac, bd, ac+bd. Edge differences of L† yield same-direction entries with a strictly positive scalar factor and D_{uu′;ss′} incidence signs: the absolute complete-graph D mass is 2(a−1), and the sum of factors across b fibers is 1/a. Transverse entries are supported exactly on 2(b−1) incident opposite-direction edges of common absolute magnitude κ, yielding RA and RB; swapping factors gives the other row. The ℓ∞ norm of a matrix is its largest absolute row sum with a sign-pattern witness. κ(r)=√r/(ar+b) has strict AM–GM maximum 1/(2√ab) precisely at r=b/a. RA−RB=2(b−a)(κ−1/(ab)) gives two distinct positive switching roots for a<b, and permanent tie for a=b. Independently inverted rational anchored Laplacians of several K_a□K_b configurations, verified exact projection row sums and idempotence; these finite tests do not establish arbitrary real positive weights, which follows from the algebraic tensor proof.
